# Omnora OS Pull Request Protocol

## 🚀 Principal Objective

A surgical summary of what this change achieves and why it is necessary for the Omnora Kernel.

## 🔗 Related Issue

Fixes # (Link the issue here)

## 🏗 Architectural Changes

- [ ] Modified State (Zustand)
- [ ] Modified Renderer (Shadow DOM / Framer Motion)
- [ ] Modified Persistence (Supabase / Edge Functions)

## 🧪 Verification Protocol

Describe the tests conducted:

- [ ] Manual Render Verification (Sub-100ms LCP)
- [ ] State Persistence Validation (Supabase Stream)
- [ ] Mobile Responsiveness (375px preview)

## 👁 Visual Evidence (Mandatory)

**Attach a screen-recording or high-fidelity screenshot below.**

PRs without visual proof for UI impact will be closed.

## 🏁 Contributor Checklist

- [ ] Follows 'Atomic Commit' protocol.
- [ ] Strict TypeScript mode (Zero warnings).
- [ ] No unnecessary 3rd party dependencies added.
- [ ] Self-reviewed for memory leaks or re-render loops.
